blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agentic image restoration composes operations to handle mixed degradations, yet its toolbox often requires storing multiple restoration networks. We propose PrismRestore, which constructs a compact bank of callable restoration actions from a single frozen all-in-one model. Our approach builds on task-dependent yet overlapping channel responses in the shared model. An offline task-prior search uses activation and gradient statistics to group channels with similar response profiles, then searches task-specific modulation coefficients over non-representative channels while leaving representative channels unmodulated. The resulting prior bank enables explicit action selection and composition without additional restoration backbones or task-specific adapter modules. A state-conditioned policy learns to compose these actions using Group Relative Policy Optimization. Its objective separately normalizes fidelity and perceptual feedback within groups of trajectories sampled for the same input, and combines terminal evaluation with return-to-go derived from stepwise quality changes. Experiments on synthetic composite-degradation and real-world multi-task benchmarks show improvements over the evaluated all-in-one baselines and restoration quality competitive with multi-model agents. PrismRestore achieves these results with a single restoration backbone and faster inference than the evaluated agentic baselines.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Images captured in uncontrolled environments often contain mixtures of noise, blur, haze, and low-light artifacts.
Sequential restoration addresses such mixtures by composing operations, each of which changes the input encountered by subsequent steps [ 3 , 43 ] .
Consequently, the usefulness of a restoration operation depends on the current image state and its position in the sequence.
This motivates policies that adapt their actions as restoration proceeds.
Realizing such policies requires a toolbox whose actions can be explicitly selected and composed at a manageable storage cost.
blocks.zh:
在不受控制的环境中捕捉到的图像往往含有噪音、模糊、雾霾和低光度文物等混合物。
顺序还原通过组合操作解决了这些混合物,每个操作都改变了后续步骤所遭遇的输入[3,43].
因此,恢复操作的有用性取决于当前图像状态及其在序列中的地位.
这促使采取一些政策,随着恢复的进行而调整其行动。
实现这些政策需要一个工具箱,其行动可以明确选择,并以可控储存成本组成。

blocks.en:
Deep image restoration has progressed from task-specific models [ 40 , 37 , 38 , 39 , 5 ] to all-in-one networks that handle multiple degradations within a shared architecture [ 28 , 6 ] .
Agentic systems further enable explicit control over restoration sequences through degradation assessment, planning, and tool invocation [ 3 , 43 ] .
Recent work advances this control through policy optimization [ 24 , 12 ] and joint optimization of planning and execution [ 42 ] .
Alongside these advances in decision-making, the way restoration actions are parameterized determines the cost of maintaining the toolbox.
blocks.zh:
深层图像修复从任务特定模型[40,37,38,39,5]到处理共享架构内多发退化的全能网络[28,6].
通过退化评估、规划和工具引用,代理人系统进一步能够对恢复序列进行明确的控制[3、43]。
最近的工作通过政策优化[24,12]和联合优化规划和执行[42]来推进这种控制.
除了决策方面的这些进展外,恢复行动参数化的方式决定了维持工具箱的费用。

blocks.en:
Many restoration agents instantiate their actions with separately parameterized models [ 3 , 43 , 24 ] , requiring a collection of full restoration networks (Fig. 1 (a)).
HybridAgent [ 19 ] reduces backbone duplication through task-specific LoRA and prompt tuning, while retaining learned adaptation parameters for individual tools (Fig. 1 (b)).
This motivates a more compact action representation: can an existing all-in-one model serve as a restoration toolbox through task-specific channel modulation, with its pretrained weights kept frozen and no additional adapters?
blocks.zh:
许多恢复剂用单独的参数化模型[3,43,24]即时化行动,需要收集完整的恢复网络(图1(a))。
HybridAgent [19]通过针对特定任务的LORA和即时调试来减少骨干重复,同时为单个工具保留所学到的适应参数(图1(b))。
这激励了更紧凑的动作表现:一个现有的一元模型能否通过任务特定的通道调制来作为恢复工具箱,其预受训练的重量会被冻结而不再有额外的适配器?

blocks.en:
Our analysis of activation and gradient statistics reveals distinct yet overlapping channel response profiles across restoration tasks within the same all-in-one model.
Task-dependent variation provides a basis for controlling restoration behavior, while the overlap suggests that some responses support multiple tasks.
Aggressive channel suppression may therefore discard information useful beyond the target task.
The challenge is to identify a compact modulation space that differentiates restoration actions while limiting disruption to shared computation.
blocks.zh:
我们对激活和梯度统计的分析显示,在同一个整体模式内,恢复任务的不同但相互重叠的渠道反应概况。
依赖于任务的变化为控制恢复行为提供了基础,而重叠表明一些响应支持多个任务.
因此,冲锋性通道压制可能会将有用的信息丢弃于目标任务之外。
挑战在于确定一个紧凑的调制空间,区分恢复行动,同时将中断限制在共享计算中.

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose PrismRestore , an agentic restoration framework that constructs a compact toolbox from a single frozen all-in-one model.
An offline task-prior search first characterizes channels using task-conditioned activation and gradient statistics and groups channels with similar response profiles.
It then searches degradation-specific modulation coefficients over non-representative channels, leaving representative channels unmodulated.
The resulting coefficient sets form a prior bank, where each prior defines a selectable restoration mode on the shared backbone.
At inference, a policy selects and applies these precomputed priors to invoke restoration actions (Fig. 1 (c)).
The toolbox stores only the pretrained restoration backbone and its compact priors, without task-specific adapters.

blocks.en:
To compose these actions, we train a policy conditioned on the current image state using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ 29 ] .
Directly aggregating fidelity and perceptual feedback makes their relative influence sensitive to metric scale.
Following prior work on decoupled multi-metric advantages [ 22 , 12 ] , we normalize these feedback signals separately within groups of trajectories sampled for the same input before advantage fusion.
We also draw on stepwise quality feedback [ 24 ] to complement terminal evaluation with return-to-go computed from quality changes after successive actions.
blocks.zh:
为了组成这些行动,我们利用集团相对政策优化(GRPO)[29]来培训以当前图像状态为条件的政策.
直接汇总忠诚度和知觉反馈使其相对影响对度量尺度敏感.
继先前关于脱钩多计量优势[22,12]的工作后,我们将这些反馈信号在优势聚变前为相同输入所取样的轨迹组内分别实现正常化.
我们还利用逐步的质量反馈[24],通过连续行动后的质量变化计算返回,补充终端评价。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce a compact restoration toolbox built from a single frozen all-in-one model. Response-guided task-prior search constructs multiple selectable restoration actions through channel modulation, requiring only one stored backbone and compact per-task coefficients. • We adapt group-relative policy learning to compose these actions according to the evolving image state, combining separately normalized fidelity and perceptual feedback with terminal evaluation and return-to-go from stepwise quality changes. • Experiments on synthetic composite-degradation and real-world multi-task benchmarks demonstrate improvements over the evaluated all-in-one baselines and restoration quality competitive with multi-model agents. PrismRestore uses a single restoration backbone and achieves faster inference than the evaluated agentic baselines.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 All-in-One Image Restoration
blocks.zh: 2.1 全方位图像修复

blocks.en:
All-in-one image restoration aims to handle diverse degradation types within a unified model [ 2 , 30 , 18 , 27 , 31 , 28 ] .
Early approaches learned degradation representations to guide a shared restoration network, while subsequent studies introduced degradation-aware prompts to adapt restoration features to different corruptions.
DA-CLIP [ 25 ] incorporates vision-language priors through degradation and content embeddings, InstructIR [ 6 ] enables restoration control using natural-language instructions, and AutoDIR [ 14 ] automatically identifies unknown degradations and restores images using a latent diffusion model.
AdaIR [ 8 ] instead exploits degradation-dependent frequency characteristics to adaptively modulate restoration features.
Moving beyond isolated degradations, OneRestore [ 10 ] constructs composite-degradation data and performs controllable restoration with scene descriptors.
Despite these advances, existing all-in-one methods generally lack explicit mechanisms for selecting and composing restoration operations according to evolving image states, limiting their flexibility in handling complex degradation combinations.
blocks.zh:
All-in-one图像修复的目的是在统一的模型[2, 30, 18, 27, 31, 28]内处理不同的降解类型.
早期的方法学习了降解表现来指导共享的恢复网络,而后进行的研究则引入了对降解的认识来促使恢复特征适应不同的腐败.
DA-CLIP [25]通过降解和内容嵌入来纳入视觉语言前缀,InstructIR [6] 能够使用自然语言指令进行恢复控制,AutoDIR [14] 使用潜在扩散模型自动识别未知降解并恢复图像.
AdaIR [8] 转而利用依赖降解的频率特性来适应性地调整恢复特性。
超越孤立降解,OneRestore[10]构建了复合降解数据,并用场景描述符进行可控还原.
尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的全能方法一般缺乏根据不断变化的图像状态选择和组合恢复操作的明确机制,限制了它们处理复杂的降解组合的灵活性.

We further evaluate on a real-world multi-task benchmark comprising 280 degraded images selected from LHP-Rain [ 9 ] and RTTS [ 17 ] .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented PrismRestore, a compact agentic image
restoration framework built upon a shared-backbone
toolbox.
By leveraging task-specific channel
modulation, our offline prior search constructs
multiple callable restoration actions from a
single frozen all-in-one model, substantially
reducing toolbox storage overhead.
A GRPO-trained
policy enables adaptive action composition
according to evolving image states, with
quality-grouped and process-aware rewards
supporting sequential optimization.
Extensive
experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks
demonstrate improved restoration performance
over the evaluated all-in-one baselines and
competitive restoration quality relative to
multi-model agents, alongside reduced toolbox
storage and improved inference efficiency.

restoration quality with minimal task-specific

quality without increasing toolbox storage
overhead remains an important direction.
Moreover, the toolbox is built for predefined
degradations, and extending it to unseen ones
may require additional prior construction
and policy adaptation.
